question: What powers arise from this stage of yogic accomplishment?
premises: Knowledge of distant hearing is attained
These are presented as related results
inference: This stage yields knowledge of distant hearing and likewise the paralysis of bonds.
uncertainties: pāśa-stobha may mean arresting or immobilizing bonds or fetters.
plain_english: O beloved, one gains knowledge of distant hearing and likewise the power to paralyze bonds.
